newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 11.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday:
* President Clinton will exercise his line-item veto authority on Monday and kill some new items from the recently signed balanced-budget and tax-cut legislation.
* Inhabitants of Montserrat are worried that all of their island may soon be unfit for human habitation after a volcano there.
* President Clinton's special envoy to the Middle East ran into obstacles Sunday as he tried to restore ties between Israel and Palestine.
* The U.S. is increasing its dependence on oil exports.
* The criminals who are deported from the U.S. are finding it surprisingly easy to return.
